title: PaperZ
body:
## I took the idea for the plugin from the Russian minecraft server MineShield

This plugin adds a unique note-creating mechanic to Minecraft! With this plugin, players can create their own notes, which can be saved, shared with others, and used for various purposes.

# How the plugin works:

To create a note, you need to hold paper in your left hand and a feather in your right hand.

You can write text using the feather in the chat, and instead of sending it to the chat, the text will be transferred to the paper's description.

Once you finish writing, the paper's name will change to "Note", and it will contain your text.

Notes can be used as regular items, passed to other players, or kept as mementos.

## Plugin features:

Easy to use — just hold two items in your hands, and it works.

Instant saving of text onto the paper.

Changes the paper's name to "Note" to make it unique.

A great tool for creating notes, memos, or even journal entries in adventure maps.

## Features:

Multiplayer support.

Easy integration into existing servers.

Right-clicking the note will display its text in the chat.

## Requirements:

Minecraft version 1.21

The plugin works only on servers with Spigot or Paper support.
